title: Comparing Subaccount Segments and Dimension Setup between Dynamics SL and Dynamics 365 Business

chapters.title: Dimension values and chart of accounts

features.name: Subaccount segments in Dynamics SL
features.description: Dynamics SL allows up to eight subaccount segments defined in the flex key definition screen. Each segment has a specific position and length, used in combination with main accounts to report and record financial data.

features.name: Segment migration to Business Central
features.description: The SL company migration configuration tool allows selection of which segments should be migrated as global dimensions in Business Central.

features.name: Global and shortcut dimensions
features.description: Business Central has two global dimensions for the most common segments, which can be easily sorted and filtered. Remaining segments are migrated as shortcut dimensions.

features.name: General ledger setup for dimensions
features.description: Business Central general ledger setup window displays configured global dimensions. Reporting unit and company segment are shown as global dimensions after migration.

features.name: Dimension values management
features.description: Business Central allows viewing and creating dimension values. Users can navigate to a specific dimension and see all segment values, with the ability to add new ones.

features.name: Chart of accounts analysis with dimensions
features.description: Business Central chart of accounts displays main accounts migrated from SL with balances broken out by dimensions like reporting unit and company segment, enabling drill-back analysis.

quotes.text: Companies may want to categorize revenue by region and market segments and expenses by department and projects.
quotes.why_it_matters: Illustrates common use cases for segments in analyzing profit and loss accounts by multiple business dimensions.

quotes.text: There can be up to eight sub account segments defined in the flex key definition screen in Dynamics SL.
quotes.why_it_matters: Establishes the maximum number of segments available in Dynamics SL for chart of accounts analysis.

quotes.text: In the SL company migration configuration tool, you can include which segments you would like to be global dimensions.
quotes.why_it_matters: Shows that segment-to-dimension mapping is configurable during migration, giving control over which segments become global dimensions.

quotes.text: Dimensions in Business Central let you categorize and analyze transactions posted to the chart of accounts instead of creating separate ledger accounts.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the functional equivalence between SL subaccount segments and BC dimensions in reducing chart of accounts complexity.
